description: This file defines the CellRange class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling ranges of cells in a spreadsheet, including validation, coordinate calculations, and string representation.

classes.name: CellRange
classes.description: Represents a range of cells in a spreadsheet, with methods for validation, coordinate calculation, and string output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CellRange object with start and end cell addresses, validating their positions.

methods.name: validateFromTo
methods.description: Ensures the 'from' and 'to' cells are correctly ordered and within the same worksheet, adjusting for top-left to bottom-right orientation.

methods.name: validateWorksheets
methods.description: Checks that the provided worksheets are in the same spreadsheet and have the same title in case of 3D ranges.

methods.name: cellAddressWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapped CellAddress object with methods to navigate neighboring cells.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the starting CellAddress of the range.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the ending CellAddress of the range.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides the string representation of the cell range, e.g., 'A1:C3'.
